title: agent_observation_record_schema.json
description: Independent fields on an agent record (D4, A5): creation provenance, ownership and review state are three separate fields, not one mutually exclusive enum. An autonomously created agent can be owned and reviewed; 'owned' never implies 'reviewed'; every field has an explicit 'unknown'. Nothing in this schema constrains one field by another.

creation_provenance.description: Who or what created the agent.

ownership_state.description: Whether a responsible owner is recorded. 'unowned' is the Observe-tier 'observed, unowned' state.

review_state.description: Whether a human review is recorded.
